settings.heading: 3x15 Runner Rug Collection – Long Lines, Quiet Character
settings.row_content:
Some spaces are easy to decorate.
Others - long hallways, narrow kitchen walkways, those in-between areas - need a little more thought.

That’s where a 3x15 runner rug comes in.

This size wasn’t made to shout. It was made to guide. To soften footsteps in a hallway. To add warmth where a room feels unfinished. To quietly pull a space together without demanding attention.

At Indian Rug Store, our Runner 3x15 collection is built around that idea: rugs that feel intentional, lived-in, and human - never generic.

settings.heading: Why a 3x15 Runner Rug Just Works
settings.row_content:
I’ve seen plenty of homes where everything looks right… except the floor. Too short. Too wide. Or simply missing something.

A 3 x 15 carpet runner solves a very specific problem. It fits long, narrow spaces the way they’re meant to be dressed - cleanly, comfortably, without visual clutter.

These runners are especially well-suited for:

  • Hallways that feel cold or echoey

  • Galley kitchens where you’re always on your feet

  • Entryways that need grounding, not bulk

  • Transitional spaces that connect rooms but get overlooked

A good 3x15 runner rug doesn’t just sit there. It leads you through the space.

settings.heading: Natural Fibers, Chosen for Real Homes
settings.row_content:
We don’t work with synthetic shortcuts. Every runner in this collection is made with natural materials - because that’s what feels right underfoot, and what lasts.

Cotton Runner Rugs

A cotton runner rug is relaxed by nature. Lighter, breathable, and soft without being precious. It’s the kind of rug that works beautifully in kitchens, casual hallways, or homes where life happens fast.

Easygoing, but never boring.

Wool Runner Rugs

If you want something with presence, a wool runner rug is hard to beat. Wool has weight. Texture. Warmth. It handles foot traffic without losing its shape and gets better with time.

Perfect for busy hallways and spaces you walk through every single day.

Washable Runner Rugs

Let’s be honest - homes aren’t museums. Spills happen. Shoes come inside. Pets don’t ask permission.

Our washable runner rugs are designed for that reality. Practical, yes, but still handcrafted, still beautiful, still far from mass-produced.

settings.heading: Handmade in India, Meant for American Homes
settings.row_content:
Every 3x15 runner rug here is handmade in India by artisans who’ve learned their craft over decades - not weeks.

You’ll notice it in the details:

  • Slight variations in weave

  • Subtle shifts in texture

  • Patterns that feel organic, not printed

Those aren’t imperfections. They’re proof that a real person made this rug.

And while the craft is traditional, the designs are chosen with US homes in mind - modern layouts, neutral palettes, and spaces that value warmth over perfection.

settings.heading: Rugs That Settle In, Not Stand Out
settings.row_content:
These aren’t trend pieces you’ll replace in a year.

Our Runner 3x15 rugs are meant to settle into your home - to look right next week, next year, and years after that. Whether your style leans modern, farmhouse, understated traditional, or somewhere in between, these runners add character without trying too hard.

They feel like they belong.

settings.heading: Find the 3x15 Runner Rug That Finishes the Space
settings.row_content:
If you’ve been staring at a long hallway or narrow kitchen thinking something’s missing, you’re probably right.

Explore our handcrafted 3 x 15 carpet runners and find the one that brings warmth, flow, and quiet confidence to your space.

Handmade. Honest. Designed to live with you.

settings.heading: What kind of spaces are best suited for a 3x15 runner rug?
settings.row_content: A 3x15 runner rug is best suited for long, narrow spaces where a regular-sized rug would look too short. Typically, these rugs are placed in hallways, galley kitchens, entryways, or as a transition between rooms. If you’ve ever felt like a room is incomplete no matter what you do, this type of rug is likely the answer.

settings.heading: How do I know if a 3x15 runner rug is the right size for me?
settings.row_content: A general guideline is to leave a little bit of floor showing on both ends, usually 6 to 12 inches. If your hallway or walkway feels like it goes on forever, a 3x15 Runner Rug will help bridge the distance without overwhelming the space.

settings.heading: Are your 3x15 runner rugs handmade?
settings.row_content: Yes. Each and every 3x15 runner rug in this collection is handmade in India by expert craftsmen. You may notice a little bit of variation in the weave, texture, or pattern - that’s what makes each one unique and authentic, rather than mass-produced.

settings.heading: How do cotton and wool runner rugs compare?
settings.row_content:
It’s really a matter of how you plan to use the room.

A cotton runner rug is lighter and more casual, perfect for kitchens or casual hallways. A wool runner rug is heavier and warmer, ideal for high-traffic areas where you want durability and comfort.

settings.heading: Can these runner rugs be used in high-traffic areas?
settings.row_content: Yes, especially our wool and flatweave styles. Wool is very durable and hides dirt well, making it a great choice for busy hallways. Cotton runners are best for low- to medium-traffic areas but are easy to clean.
